error[ZC-E0810]: a certificate is not signed by the pinned CA
  cause  node2's certificate was refused: its signature does not verify under
         the pinned CA key
  fix    check that both sides use this cluster's CA (docs/peer.md)
  more   zcube explain E0810 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0810.html
